instruction: Use a Fusion 360 API script or command-line automation workflow for Fusion-compatible CAM generation. Read the initial file(s) from the Desktop path(s): C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\slot_plate.step, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\tools.csv. Using the CLI workflow, create a 2D Pocket or slot milling operation for C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\slot_plate.step. Machine the centered 40 x 8 slot down to Z=0.000 mm with T1, a 6 mm flat end mill, at S8500 rpm and F500 mm/min. Export C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\task-22.nc and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\task-22_summary.json. Tool definition: T1 is a 6 mm flat end mill, S8500 rpm, F500 mm/min. Write the output file(s) to the Desktop path(s) using exactly these absolute file paths: C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\task-22.nc, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\task-22_summary.json.

command: if exist "C:\Users\Administrator\AppData\Local\Autodesk\webdeploy\production\6a0c9611291d45bb9226980209917c3d\FusionLauncher.exe" (echo OK) else (echo MISSING & exit /b 1)
